label: Electricity
description: Analyze electrical circuit diagrams by cutting them into 9 tiles and comparing initial vs solved states using a chosen LLM.

steps.label: Reset board
steps.detail: Start from a known initial state

steps.label: Localize grid
steps.detail: Determine the bounding box of the 3×3 grid in the image

steps.label: Cut into tiles
steps.detail: Extract 9 individual tiles from both the current and target images

steps.label: Compare tile pairs
steps.detail: For each position send the current and target tile to a vision model

steps.label: Send rotations to hub
steps.detail: Apply the required rotations one by one via the hub API

steps.label: Verify and repeat
steps.detail: Fetch the updated board and repeat until the flag is returned
